# SCI-POINT ODQ-001 Scientific-Owner Approval

Record identity: `SCI-POINT-ODQ-001-APPROVAL-2026-09-02`

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson

Status: decided

## Approved Decision

The scientific owner approved the Stage A recommendation for
`SCI-POINT-ODQ-001`.

SCI-POINT v0.1 ends with authoritative per-array Pointing measurements. It does
not own or publish a cross-array aggregate displacement.

Cross-array aggregation remains the responsibility of the named
pointing-support producer. That producer must declare its exact participating
array measurements, admission/exclusion rule, weighting, covariance or
dependence treatment, partial-array policy, failure behavior, method/version,
and provenance. The aggregate cannot modify or conceal the original per-array
SCI-POINT results.

This decision preserves the recovered working division of responsibility:
Citlali publishes per-array Pointing measurements, while the downstream
producer constructs any observation-level aggregate needed for a correction
record.

## Non-Effects

This decision does not approve a particular aggregation rule, arithmetic mean,
correction sign, telescope-offset composition, pointing-record selection,
interpolation, or application method. It does not answer ODQ-002 through
ODQ-009, admit a numerical parent route, launch Stage B, change an algorithm,
or establish implementation conformity, validation, achieved performance,
readiness, or production state.
